text.zh: 新增 Qwen Image 3.0 Pro、JoyAI-Video-Edit、QuerySplat、InfiniSplat 与 LeapTalk。前者为阿里云限量预览 API，其余四项均有官方可下载权重；同时把 FLUX 3 Video 从 early access 更新为正式 API，并补充 Veo 3.1 Lite 的编辑与原生音频能力边界。
text.en: Added Qwen Image 3.0 Pro, JoyAI-Video-Edit, QuerySplat, InfiniSplat, and LeapTalk. Qwen is a limited-preview API; the other four provide official downloadable weights. FLUX 3 Video is now recorded as a generally available API, and Veo 3.1 Lite now captures documented editing and native-audio capability boundaries.

text.zh: 新增 Hypersim、DL3DV-Evaluation、ETH3D、ScanNet++、Tanks and Temples、VividHead 与 LongV2VBench。前六项均给出官方浏览或下载入口及访问条件；LongV2VBench 虽被论文正式命名并披露 229 个任务，但文件未发布，因此保持 unavailable 且不提供伪下载链接。
text.en: Added Hypersim, DL3DV-Evaluation, ETH3D, ScanNet++, Tanks and Temples, VividHead, and LongV2VBench. The first six have official access paths and explicit conditions. LongV2VBench is named and sized at 229 tasks but remains unavailable because no artifact has been released.

text.zh: 新增 12 条可解析模型—数据集关系：JoyAI 关联 OpenVE-Bench/LongV2VBench；QuerySplat 区分 DL3DV-10K 训练与 DL3DV-Evaluation 评测；InfiniSplat 仅以 Hypersim 训练、四个真实数据集评测；LeapTalk 以 VividHead 蒸馏、HDTF/CelebV-HQ 评测。
text.en: Added twelve resolvable relations. Training, distillation, and evaluation roles remain separate, especially for QuerySplat, InfiniSplat, and LeapTalk.

text.zh: Arena 文生图新增第 5 名 Qwen Image 3.0 Pro 并完成映射；Artificial Analysis 图片编辑榜 Reve 2.1 新进第 1，文生视频榜发生 Kling 3.0、Wan 2.7 与 Veo 3.1 Fast/Lite 的顺位变化。最终无未映射的榜单模型。
text.en: Mapped the new Arena #5 Qwen Image 3.0 Pro entry. Reve 2.1 entered the Artificial Analysis editing board at #1, while Kling, Wan, and Veo variants changed order on text-to-video. Final ranking coverage has no unresolved model.

text.zh: 一手来源监控新增 12 个精确模型/数据集探针及相关项目源；FASHN VTON 1.5 的不稳定项目页被官方 GitHub 与已有精确模型探针替代。最终扫描 413 个来源，来源失败和排行榜缺口均为零。
text.en: Added twelve precise model and dataset probes plus project sources. Replaced the unstable FASHN research page with its official GitHub and existing precise model probe; the final scan has no source failure or ranking gap.

text.zh: Qwen Image 3.0 Pro 未披露模型架构与任何训练数据；JoyAI 虽披露各阶段规模和过滤/合成方法，但未命名源语料；QuerySplat/InfiniSplat/LeapTalk 均仍受冻结基础模型的继承数据未知影响。VividHead 许可元数据与正文不一致，Tanks and Temples 许可页也存在相互冲突的开放与非商业条款。
text.en: Qwen discloses no training data; JoyAI reports stage scales and processing without naming source corpora; inherited checkpoint lineage remains incomplete for QuerySplat, InfiniSplat, and LeapTalk. VividHead and Tanks and Temples each have internally inconsistent license signals that require review.

text.zh: 新增 VTON 360 历史模型卡，按 2025-03-15 官方论文日期排序；官方提供 THuman/MVHumanNet 两套百度 checkpoint，但没有 API，也未声明官方代码或权重许可。另补充 Grok Imagine Video 1.5 的 Arena 720p 排行榜别名。
text.en: Added a verified historical card for VTON 360, ordered by its 2025-03-15 official paper date. Official THuman and MVHumanNet checkpoints are downloadable from Baidu, but no API or official code/checkpoint license is stated. Also mapped the Arena 720p alias for Grok Imagine Video 1.5.

text.zh: 新增 THuman2.0、CultureVidBench 与 MIE-Bench。THuman2.0 为申请制、非商业且禁止再分发；两个新评测均公布规模，但实际文件尚不可下载，因此明确记录 unavailable 且不提供伪下载链接。
text.en: Added THuman2.0, CultureVidBench, and MIE-Bench. THuman2.0 is request-gated, non-commercial, and non-redistributable; both new benchmarks disclose their scale but do not currently provide downloadable files, so they remain explicitly unavailable.

text.zh: 新增 VTON 360 到 THuman2.0 与 MVHumanNet 的四条关系，分别保留 fine-tuning 与 evaluation 角色；Stable Diffusion v1.5 继承语料维持 undisclosed，不创建无证据 catalog_id。
text.en: Added four VTON 360 relations to THuman2.0 and MVHumanNet, preserving separate fine-tuning and evaluation roles. The inherited Stable Diffusion v1.5 corpus remains undisclosed without an unsupported catalog ID.

text.zh: 记录 Arena 文生视频及 Artificial Analysis 图片编辑、图生视频、文生视频四榜变化；修复 Arena 图生视频端点并补齐 Grok Imagine Video 1.5 720p 映射后，所有前 15 名称均可解析。
text.en: Recorded changes on Arena text-to-video and three Artificial Analysis boards. After repairing Arena image-to-video ingestion and mapping the Grok Imagine Video 1.5 720p name, every monitored top-15 entry resolves to a model card.

text.zh: 监控扩至 401 个一手来源，加入 VTON 360、THuman2.0、CultureVidBench 与 MIE-Bench 精确探针，并把 Arena 图生视频从失败的 filter 查询迁移至官方 first-rows 端点；最终扫描 0 失败、0 coverage gap。
text.en: Expanded monitoring to 401 primary sources with precise VTON 360, THuman2.0, CultureVidBench, and MIE-Bench probes. Replaced the failing Arena image-to-video filter query with the official first-rows endpoint; the final scan has zero failures and zero coverage gaps.

text.zh: VTON 360 未披露官方 checkpoint 许可、基础模型精确继承链、训练混合/算力/筛选与电商服装权利；CultureVidBench 与 MIE-Bench 未公开文件、许可、源内容权利及完整标注协议，MIE 官方占位下载当前返回 404。
text.en: VTON 360 does not disclose its official checkpoint license, exact inherited base lineage, training mixture, compute, filtering, or commerce-garment rights. CultureVidBench and MIE-Bench do not publish their files, licenses, source-content rights, or full annotation protocols, and MIE's advertised placeholder download currently returns 404.

text.zh: 新增 Qwen-Image-SP、MoRoute、Helios、SeFi-Image 与 Qwen-Image。Qwen-Image-SP 公开 Apache-2.0 图像权重及独立 35B-A3B 结构化提示扩展器；MoRoute 公布统一 T2V/I2V/参考生成/视频编辑方法但尚无代码、权重或 API；Helios 补齐 2026-03-04 已公开的 14B 实时长视频模型缺口；SeFi-Image 补齐 1B/2B/5B Base、Turbo 与 5B RL 非商业权重家族；Qwen-Image 补齐 2025-08-04 的 20B Apache-2.0 开放权重及其分阶段数据策略。
text.en: Added Qwen-Image-SP, MoRoute, Helios, SeFi-Image, and Qwen-Image. The additions cover current structured-conditioning and routing releases plus verified historical gaps for open long-video, semantic-first image generation, and Qwen's 20B image family.

text.zh: 新增 25 张数据卡：Context Scaling 五套语料，MoRoute 的公开、受限及未发布训练/评测来源，Helios 三套训练/蒸馏/评测资源，SeFi-Image 的 450M 内部预训练、28M 合成文字、9M 续训、约 650K SFT 与 DiffusionNFT 提示池，以及 Qwen-Image 的 VAE 文字密集语料、预训练混合、SFT 与 DPO 偏好。下载状态、访问门槛、许可与缺失链接分别记录，不以模型许可覆盖训练媒体权利。
text.en: Added twenty-five cards spanning Context Scaling, MoRoute, Helios, SeFi-Image, and Qwen-Image training, distillation, preference, and evaluation resources. Public, gated, and unavailable access are represented separately, and existing upstream cards are reused by relation.

text.zh: 新增 28 条模型—数据集关系：Qwen-Image-SP 五条、MoRoute 十条、Helios 三条、SeFi-Image 六条、Qwen-Image 四条。MoRoute LAION 子集、Helios ODE 对、SeFi 合成文字语料及续训混合共新增四条数据 lineage；评估集保持 evaluation-only，继承自 BAGEL、Wan2.1、Qwen3.5 等模型的未披露血缘没有伪造 catalog_id。
text.en: Added 28 model-to-dataset edges across the five families and four dataset-lineage edges. Evaluation suites remain evaluation-only, and inherited undisclosed corpora are not assigned fabricated catalog IDs.

text.zh: Artificial Analysis 图像编辑榜中 FLUX.2 [max] 15→14、Kling Image 3.0 14→13、HiDream-O1-Image 13→15；图生视频榜 Vidu Q3 Pro 进入第 15、Veo 3.1 Lite 移出；文生视频榜 Kling 3.0 Omni 720p Standard 与 1080p Pro 分别 13→12、12→13。当前前 15 名称全部可解析，不从榜单能力或名次推断训练数据。
text.en: Artificial Analysis moved FLUX.2 [max] to 14, Kling Image 3.0 to 13, and HiDream-O1-Image to 15 in image editing, replaced Veo 3.1 Lite with Vidu Q3 Pro at image-to-video rank 15, and swapped the two Kling 3.0 Omni text-to-video variants at ranks 12 and 13. All top-15 entries remain mapped.

text.zh: 新增 Context Scaling、MoRoute、Helios、SeFi-Image 与 Qwen-Image 官方项目/组织广域源，以及 5 个模型和 25 个数据集的一手 revision 探针；公开 Hugging Face 数据集和模型页加入候选排除表，避免将已覆盖条目反复当作新发布。PosterCraft、Wan 2.7、LTX-2.3、Dailymotion、Pexels 的 revision 均完成内容核对；WorldWeaver 仍因 Physical AI/交互环境范围明确排除。未修改 `sources/scenarios.yaml`，未创建 Physical AI 分类。
text.en: Added primary project, organization, and revision probes for all five models and 25 datasets, and excluded accepted Hugging Face pages from repeated candidate discovery. Six important revisions were reviewed without inventing new facts. No Physical AI category or scenario was added.

text.zh: Qwen-Image-SP 未披露原始图片来源、权利、扩散微调规模、六类 RFT 提示源与 35B 公开扩展器相对论文 397B LoRA 的迁移方法；MoRoute 未披露内部视频、UE5 资产、各公开源实际贡献、权重与模型许可；Helios 未披露 0.8M 视频来源、过滤/去重/安全策略、ODE 对规模和完整 Wan2.1 血缘；SeFi-Image 未披露 450M 内部图片来源与权利、9M/650K 混合组成、合成字体许可及 RL 总迭代；Qwen-Image 未披露所有阶段的总规模、来源身份、许可与组件级配比。RefVIE-Bench 无数据集许可证；多套公开数据仍需分层复核媒体权利或非商业限制。
text.en: Qwen-Image-SP, MoRoute, and Helios retain the source and scale gaps detailed above. SeFi-Image omits internal-image provenance, later-stage mixture composition, synthetic font rights, and total RL iterations; Qwen-Image omits stage totals, source identities, licenses, and component-level weights. Several public datasets retain layered or non-commercial media rights.

text.zh: 新增 Wonder：Adobe Research 与 Johns Hopkins University 于 2026-07-28 公布的相机可控实时视频生成系统。它以 Wan2.1-I2V-14B 初始化双向教师，再蒸馏为四步、三学生生成器的因果流式系统，支持图生视频和视频重拍、分钟级 16 FPS 生成与稀疏长程记忆；代码、权重、API 与模型许可证均未发布。
text.en: Added Wonder, an announced camera-controlled I2V/V2V streaming system initialized from Wan2.1-I2V-14B and distilled into a four-step, three-student causal generator. No code, weights, API, or model license is released.

text.zh: 新增 MultiCamVideo、CamXTime、Wonder UE I2V Corpus、Wonder Blender V2V Corpus、Wonder I2V Benchmark、Wonder V2V Benchmark 与 MPIE-Bench 七张数据卡。前两项分别记录 333 GB 可直接下载的 136,000 条 UE5 多机位视频和需研究机构申请的 360,960 条完整时空网格视频；Wonder 两套合成训练语料和两套评测集均未发布；MPIE-Bench 已在官方仓库公开 2,500 个多人交互编辑测试样本与评分代码。
text.en: Added MultiCamVideo, CamXTime, two unreleased Wonder training corpora, two unreleased Wonder benchmarks, and the public MPIE-Bench test pack, with public, gated, and unavailable access represented separately.

text.zh: 新增 Wonder→DL3DV、MultiCamVideo、CamXTime、Wonder UE I2V Corpus、Wonder Blender V2V Corpus 五条微调关系，以及 Wonder→Wonder I2V/V2V Benchmark 两条评测关系。Wan2.1 继承数据单独记为未披露预训练血缘，不把评测集写成训练集。
text.en: Added five Wonder fine-tuning edges and two evaluation edges. The inherited Wan2.1 mixture remains explicitly undisclosed, and neither benchmark is represented as training data.

text.zh: Artificial Analysis 图像编辑榜发生七处变化；生视频榜 Veo 3.1 Lite 进入图生视频前 15、Vidu Q3 Pro 移出，文生视频榜 Wan 2.7 与 SkyReels V4 互换第 8/9。所有前列名称仍可解析到模型卡，榜单只作为监控信号，不用于反推训练数据。
text.en: Artificial Analysis recorded seven image-editing movements, Veo 3.1 Lite entering the image-to-video top 15, and Wan 2.7 swapping with SkyReels V4 in text-to-video. Every current top-15 name remains mapped.

text.zh: 新增 Wonder、MultiCamVideo、CamXTime 与 MPIE-Bench 一手探针，并把相机可控、交互式和长视频生成映射到既有生视频场景。Pexels 访问卡补充默认 200 次/小时、20,000 次/月限额、无限调用审核条件、可返回媒体尺寸和不返回标题/标签/详细统计的边界；API 可访问不代表获得训练权利。未创建 Physical AI 分类或公开入口。
text.en: Added primary probes for Wonder, MultiCamVideo, CamXTime, and MPIE-Bench and expanded the existing video-generation scenario mapping. Pexels now records exact default quotas and response-field boundaries. No Physical AI category was introduced.

text.zh: Wonder 未披露各训练源精确留存量与混合权重、合成资产来源和许可、继承自 Wan2.1 的完整数据血缘、总训练步数、最终系统参数占用、代码、权重、API 与模型许可证。其四套未发布语料/评测集缺少文件、逐项来源和许可证；CamXTime 未声明数据许可证；MultiCamVideo 的 Fab/Mixamo 资产权利需另审；MPIE-Bench 的 Pexels、Harmony4D 与 CHI3D 媒体权利仍分层适用。
text.en: Wonder omits exact retained counts and mixture weights, synthetic-asset provenance and licenses, inherited Wan2.1 lineage, system footprint, code, weights, API, and model license. CamXTime, MultiCamVideo, and MPIE-Bench retain distinct dataset or upstream-media rights gaps.

text.zh: 新增 Seedance 2.5 与 InstructAV2AV 两张模型卡；前者是最长 30 秒、支持参考控制和音视频联合编辑的产品模型，后者是已开放 Apache-2.0 权重的指令式音视频编辑模型。同步更新 Grok Imagine Video 1.5 的文生视频、图像/预设声线参考能力。
text.en: Added Seedance 2.5 and InstructAV2AV. Seedance 2.5 is a product-only joint audiovisual generation and editing model supporting up to 30 seconds; InstructAV2AV releases Apache-2.0 weights for instruction-driven audiovisual editing. Grok Imagine Video 1.5 now records text, image-reference, and preset-voice-reference generation.

text.zh: 新增 InsAVE-80K、MovieBench、Condensed Movies、Short-Films-20K 与 AvED-Bench 五张数据卡；分别记录可下载的 139 GB 音视频编辑对、三项上游长视频来源和 110 条评测元数据的访问与分层权利边界。
text.en: Added InsAVE-80K, MovieBench, Condensed Movies, Short-Films-20K, and AvED-Bench, covering a downloadable 139 GB audiovisual editing release, three upstream long-video sources, and 110 benchmark metadata rows with explicit layered-rights notes.

text.zh: 新增 InstructAV2AV→InsAVE-80K 微调关系和 InstructAV2AV→AvED-Bench 评测关系；新增 InsAVE-80K 对 MovieBench、Condensed Movies、Short-Films-20K、VGGSound 的四条 source-component lineage，以及 AvED-Bench→VGGSound 的 benchmark-derivative lineage。
text.en: Added InstructAV2AV fine-tuning and evaluation edges to InsAVE-80K and AvED-Bench, four InsAVE source-component edges, and one AvED-Bench benchmark-derivative edge to VGGSound. Evaluation data remains separate from training data.

text.zh: Artificial Analysis 图像编辑榜发生七处名次调整：MAI-Image-2.5 升至第 3、Nano Banana 2 降至第 4、Nano Banana Pro 升至第 5、Seedream 5.0 Pro 降至第 6、FLUX.2 max 升至第 13，HiDream 与 Kling Image 3.0 顺移；文生图榜 GPT Image 1.5 high 与 Nano Banana 2 互换第 5/6。没有未映射的前列模型。
text.en: Artificial Analysis changed seven image-editing positions, led by MAI-Image-2.5 rising to #3 and Nano Banana 2 falling to #4; GPT Image 1.5 high and Nano Banana 2 swapped #5/#6 in text-to-image. Every ranked name remains mapped to a canonical model card.

text.zh: 新增 Seedance 2.5、InstructAV2AV、InsAVE-80K、MovieBench、Condensed Movies、Short-Films-20K 与 AvED-Bench 的一手探针，并把 audio-video-editing、video-extension 纳入生视频场景映射；未创建 Physical AI 分类或发现入口。
text.en: Added primary-source probes for both new models and all five new dataset cards, and mapped audio-video editing and video extension into the public video-generation scenario. No Physical AI category or discovery feed was introduced.

text.zh: Seedance 2.5 未披露架构、参数、技术报告、API、权重或任何训练数据；InstructAV2AV 未给出最终参数量、完整混合权重、逐来源留存量和继承自 Ovi 的预训练血缘；InsAVE-80K 的底层媒体权利、去重与论文 79K/公开版 87,074 训练对差异仍需逐项审计；AvED-Bench 未声明数据许可证。
text.en: Seedance 2.5 publishes no architecture, parameter count, report, API, weights, or training data. InstructAV2AV omits final size, full mixture weights, retained counts, and inherited Ovi lineage. InsAVE retains layered-media, deduplication, and 79K-versus-87,074 reconciliation gaps; AvED-Bench states no dataset license.

text.zh: 新增 MiniMax H3、ShadowDancer、S-Avatar、UniGen-AR 与 ReMind 5B 五张模型卡：覆盖统一多模态视频、动作条件世界模型、单图 3D 头部数字人、统一视觉生成和动态记忆视频生成。
text.en: Added MiniMax H3, ShadowDancer, S-Avatar, UniGen-AR, and ReMind 5B, covering unified multimodal video, action-conditioned world modeling, single-image 3D head avatars, unified visual generation, and dynamic-memory video generation.

text.zh: 新增十三张数据卡，包含 Shadow Library、NeRSemble、DL3DV-10K、MiraData、Open X-Embodiment、ReMind1M、未发布的 ReMind Pexels 动态片段，以及 UniGen-AR 的五项公开训练来源和独立评测套件；每张卡均记录访问边界、下载入口与权利限制。
text.en: Added thirteen dataset cards: Shadow Library, NeRSemble, DL3DV-10K, MiraData, Open X-Embodiment, ReMind1M, an unreleased ReMind Pexels corpus, five public UniGen-AR training sources, and its separate evaluation suite.

text.zh: 新增十二条模型到数据集关系和四条数据集 lineage；S-Avatar 的 NeRSemble 与 UniGen-AR 的六项 benchmark 明确保持 evaluation-only，ShadowDancer 只把未发布的 Shadow Library 写成微调语料，ReMind 的公开和未发布来源分别关联。
text.en: Added twelve model-to-dataset relations and four dataset-lineage edges. NeRSemble and all six UniGen-AR benchmarks remain evaluation-only; ReMind's public and unreleased sources are separated.

text.zh: Artificial Analysis 的 MiniMax-H3 新进图生视频第 3、文生视频第 2、视频编辑第 1，并触发相邻名次顺移；图像编辑中 Seedream 5.0 Pro 升至第 5、Gemini 3 Pro Image 降至第 6。
text.en: MiniMax-H3 entered Artificial Analysis at #3 for image-to-video, #2 for text-to-video, and #1 for video editing, shifting adjacent entries; Seedream 5.0 Pro rose to #5 in image editing while Gemini 3 Pro Image fell to #6.

text.zh: 为五个新模型和十三张新数据卡建立一手探针，Sana Video 2 的限流探针改用稳定 arXiv 页面；按当前范围移除 Physical AI 场景分类及世界模型/机器人视频主动发现入口，目录继续聚焦生成式媒体应用。
text.en: Created primary-source probes for all five models and thirteen datasets, and replaced Sana Video 2's rate-limited probe with a stable arXiv page. The Physical AI category and the world-model/robot-video discovery feeds were removed so the catalog remains focused on generative-media applications.

text.zh: MiniMax H3 未披露任何训练语料或技术报告；Shadow Library 未发布文件、完整配比和统一许可；S-Avatar 继承组件的数据 lineage 未重述；UniGen-AR 虽披露 800 万训练对，但未发布权重、代码、最终参数量和完整去重方案；ReMind 未披露完整来源配比和 Pexels 留存清单。
text.en: MiniMax H3 discloses no training corpus or technical report; Shadow Library has no files, complete mixture, or unified license; S-Avatar does not restate inherited-component lineage; UniGen-AR discloses its 8M-pair mix but not artifacts or complete deduplication; ReMind omits full mixture weights and its retained Pexels manifest.

text.zh: 新增 Oxygen-TryOn、ID-V2V 与 JoyFox LiveTalk-DH 1.3B 三张模型卡，并把 Grok Imagine Video 1.5 的访问地址更新为官方稳定 API 页面。
text.en: Added model cards for Oxygen-TryOn, ID-V2V, and JoyFox LiveTalk-DH 1.3B, and replaced the Grok Imagine Video 1.5 access URL with its stable official API page.

text.zh: 新增九张数据卡，并确认 MV-Fashion 的受控仓库已实际上传按主体拆分的视频和标注压缩包；其访问仍须人工审批及签署非商业研究协议。
text.en: Added nine dataset cards and confirmed that the gated MV-Fashion repository now contains per-subject video and annotation archives; access still requires manual approval and the non-commercial research agreement.

text.zh: 新增六条模型到数据集关系和两条数据集衍生关系；训练、奖励模型、强化学习、评测与上游组件保持独立，不把评测集写成训练数据。
text.en: Added six model-to-dataset relations and two dataset-lineage relations. Training, reward-model, reinforcement-learning, evaluation, and upstream-component roles remain separate.

text.zh: 图像与视频榜单完成两轮更新；最新一轮文生图、文生视频和图生视频榜单出现顺序变化，所有前列名称仍已映射到模型卡。
text.en: Image and video leaderboards were refreshed twice. The latest text-to-image, text-to-video, and image-to-video snapshots changed order, while every leading entry remains mapped to a model card.

text.zh: 监控扩大到 328 个一手来源，新增 17 个 Hugging Face 模型发布 feed，覆盖图像/视频生成与编辑、数字人/本地化、试衣、音视频和 3D，并对 LoRA、量化、镜像与 Demo 自动降级。
text.en: Expanded monitoring to 328 primary sources with seventeen Hugging Face model-release feeds covering image/video generation and editing, digital humans/localization, try-on, audio-video, and 3D; LoRA, quantized, mirror, and demo repositories are automatically demoted.

text.zh: Oxygen-TryOn、ID-V2V 与 JoyFox LiveTalk-DH 均未完整披露训练来源、权利基础和配比；Hugging Face 上的搬运仓与衍生权重不视为新模型发布。
text.en: Oxygen-TryOn, ID-V2V, and JoyFox LiveTalk-DH still do not fully disclose training provenance, rights basis, or source mixture. Hugging Face reuploads and derivative weights are not treated as new model releases.

text.zh: 本轮没有发现证据充分的新模型或需要修改事实卡的模型版本；已跟踪的主流图像、视频、数字人和试衣模型保持不变。
text.en: No new model or model-version change had sufficient evidence in this review. Tracked image, video, digital-human, and virtual try-on models remain unchanged.

text.zh: 没有新增数据集；PosterCraft 等公开数据页面的规模和许可结论未发生实质变化。
text.en: No dataset was added. Public pages such as PosterCraft did not materially change their scale or licensing evidence.

text.zh: 没有新增训练、微调、偏好或评测关系；九个机器候选均未形成可核验的新数据血缘。
text.en: No training, fine-tuning, preference, or evaluation relation was added. None of the nine machine candidates formed a verifiable new data lineage.

text.zh: 图生视频榜单出现一次明确换位：Dreamina Seedance 2.0 720p 升至第一，Gemini Omni Flash 降至第二。
text.en: The image-to-video leaderboard had one confirmed swap: Dreamina Seedance 2.0 720p moved to first place and Gemini Omni Flash moved to second.

text.zh: 更新 Dailymotion API v2 资料并替换四个不稳定探针；298 个一手来源的最终复扫无失败、无恢复项、无排行榜映射缺口。
text.en: Updated the Dailymotion API v2 reference and replaced four unstable probes. The final scan of 298 primary sources had no failures, recoveries, or ranking-mapping gaps.

text.zh: 多家模型页面虽有内容更新，但没有新增训练数据名称、规模、清洗方法、合成策略或许可信息，因此未推进核验日期。
text.en: Several model pages changed, but none disclosed new training-data names, scale, cleaning, synthesis, or licensing facts, so their verification dates were not advanced.

text.zh: 集中补齐世界模型、视频编辑、影视配音、口型同步、视频试衣、3D 生成和统一图文生成模型，代表性新增或更新包括 WorldWeaver、Solaris、ElasticTTT、Mage-Flow、InnoText、AgentHOI 与 fMRI2Face。
text.en: Expanded coverage across world models, video editing, film dubbing, lip sync, video try-on, 3D generation, and unified image-text generation. Representative additions include WorldWeaver, Solaris, ElasticTTT, Mage-Flow, InnoText, AgentHOI, and fMRI2Face.

text.zh: 为新增模型补齐公开下载、受限申请和未发布三类数据卡，重点覆盖 Solaris、DAVIS、CineDub、CelebV-Dub、TryAny-Bench、ViViD、ConsIDVid 等数据资产。
text.en: Added public-download, gated-access, and unreleased dataset cards for the new models, including Solaris, DAVIS, CineDub, CelebV-Dub, TryAny-Bench, ViViD, and ConsIDVid assets.

text.zh: 模型与数据集关系扩展到 129 条，数据集衍生关系达到 27 条；训练、评测、运行时输入和继承数据被分别标注，并修复了页面中的关系跳转。
text.en: Expanded model-to-dataset relations to 129 and dataset lineage to 27. Training, evaluation, runtime inputs, and inherited data are labeled separately, and relation navigation was repaired.

text.zh: 扩展多家供应方的图像与视频排行榜覆盖，记录 Recraft V4.1 与 Grok Imagine Image Quality 的名次互换，并补齐前列模型映射。
text.en: Expanded image and video leaderboard coverage across providers, recorded the Recraft V4.1 and Grok Imagine Image Quality position swap, and completed mappings for leading models.

text.zh: 监控范围扩大到 298 个一手来源，新增世界模型、配音、试衣和 3D 数据的重点探针；最终扫描没有来源失败或排行榜映射缺口。
text.en: Expanded monitoring to 298 primary sources, adding priority probes for world models, dubbing, try-on, and 3D data. The final scan had no source failures or ranking-mapping gaps.

text.zh: 多项论文只披露数据规模或处理流程，未发布语料文件、来源清单或完整许可；脑信号、人脸、影视素材和游戏数据继续保留隐私与权利边界。
text.en: Several papers disclose only data scale or processing, without releasing corpus files, source inventories, or complete licensing. Privacy and rights boundaries remain explicit for brain signals, faces, film footage, and game data.

text.zh: 首轮集中补齐图像、视频、数字人、虚拟试衣、音频和 3D 模型，代表性新增包括 Midjourney V8.2、Muse Image / Video、Omni2Sound、SANA-Video 2.0、Mage-Flow、TalkVerse-5B 与 OpenVE-Edit。
text.en: Established the first broad set of image, video, digital-human, virtual try-on, audio, and 3D model cards. Representative additions include Midjourney V8.2, Muse Image / Video, Omni2Sound, SANA-Video 2.0, Mage-Flow, TalkVerse-5B, and OpenVE-Edit.

text.zh: 新增 SoundAtlas、Cap3D、Objaverse-XL、完整 Omni2Sound 音频语料链，以及 Try-On、数字人、图像生成和视频编辑方向的一批公开或受限数据卡。
text.en: Added SoundAtlas, Cap3D, Objaverse-XL, the complete Omni2Sound audio lineage, and a set of public or restricted cards for try-on, digital humans, image generation, and video editing.

text.zh: 建立模型到训练、微调、偏好和评测数据的明确关系，并加入数据集之间的衍生链路；评测集、未发布语料和可下载训练集不再混写。
text.en: Established explicit model links to training, fine-tuning, preference, and evaluation data, plus dataset-lineage edges. Evaluation sets, unreleased corpora, and downloadable training data are no longer conflated.

text.zh: 开始维护五个主流图像与视频榜单的前列模型，首批记录 66 个席位；所有重点席位都要求能映射到具体模型卡。
text.en: Began maintaining leading entries from five major image and video leaderboards, recording 66 positions. Every priority entry must resolve to a model card.

text.zh: 建立覆盖模型、数据集、官方仓库和新数据发布源的持续监控体系，并让关系变化能够反向定位受影响的模型和数据集。
text.en: Established continuous monitoring across models, datasets, official repositories, and new-data release sources, with relation changes traceable back to affected models and datasets.

text.zh: 多项闭源或 API 模型仍未公开训练语料名称、来源权利和配比；目录明确保留“未披露”，不根据生成能力猜测训练数据。
text.en: Many closed or API-only models still do not disclose training-corpus names, source rights, or mixtures. The catalog preserves “undisclosed” instead of inferring training data from capabilities.
